svg.title: Standing electron waves on the third and fourth orbits
svg.desc: The third and fourth allowed orbits, with radii r3 and r4 in the ratio 9 : 16, shown as dashed circles. The electron’s wave fits exactly three wavelengths, λ3, around the third orbit and four, λ4, around the fourth. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: An integer number of wavelengths closes smoothly around a ring
Historical Bohr–de Broglie boundary-condition model. Radial displacement draws wave amplitude, not an
electron orbit. The phase clock is illustrative; no electron tracer is shown.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
